copy.headline: Dallas Cowboys mark 30 years of giving back with Salvation Army
copy.caption: The Dallas Cowboys celebrated 30 years of partnership with the Salvation Army by serving early Thanksgiving meals at facilities in Dallas and Fort Worth.
